# New Pokemons:

# Atlas

The late game (post stage 20) has received a complete overhaul. At stage 20, you now receive the Connection Orb. The Connection Orb allows you to browse the Atlas, a new tree-based progression system that let you explore different paths to unlock the many new late-game mechanics we added this patch, and reconnect with the residents of Treasure Town.

The Atlas is inspired by the Connection Orb mechanic from Pokémon Super Mystery Dungeon. The number of paths you can follow is enormous. Our goal is to make every game even more unique. The same team composition will have a different outcome depending on the Atlas path you choose. All the team caps have been raised, and the game can be turned around at any stage with much more comeback options available to everyone.

# Stellar synergy

We introduce what will be the final 32th synergy to Pokémon Auto Chess: STELLAR

This special synergy is only given through special items and Pokémon. Its effect is to increase by 1 the synergy level of all active synergies, and Stellar Pokémon benefit from the effects of all active synergies. Stellar cannot be a symbol on portals. A STELLAR_GEM exists but cannot be sold by Sableye town encounter.

# Changes to Synergies

- Fire 8 rework: no longer gives Fire Shard. After 10 seconds, the whole board is set on fire and BURN all Pokémon, allies and enemies, and your FIRE Pokémon gain 15 SPEED.
- Baby 7: Golden eggs now give an EMERA when hatched. Removed the limit of max 1 golden egg on bench.

# Changes to Pokemon & Abilities

- 32 new Z-Move abilities have been added to the game, one for each synergy.


# Changes to Items

> Shiny items have long been a subject of debate, some players did not like how much variance they brought to the game. We decided to review the category completely, tuning down their effects a bit, reserving them for the very late game, and replacing many of them with more exciting effects.

- Shiny Items have been renamed to Atlas Items, and are now obtainable only through the Atlas.
- New Atlas Item: Tera Orb - The holder replaced their base types with the STELLAR type
- New Atlas Item: Z-Ring - The holder's max PP is changed to 200 and their ability is changed to the chosen Z-Move ability. Each synergy has a Z-Move ability associated with it.
- New Atlas Item: Looplet - Up to 5 EMERA can be sealed in the looplet, each granting additional stats and effects to the holder. Gain 1 EMERA when acquired.
- Removed Shiny Items: Red Scale (moved to Special), Shiny stone (moved to Light 7 synergy effect), Eviolite, Gold Bottle Cap, Absorb Bulb, Sacred Ash
- There are now 10 different sorts of fossil stones. They all work the same as an item component, but now have a unique interaction with Ditto.
- Exp Share is no longer a tool, but a special item given on shiny Stage 15 PvE encounter
- Red Scale rework: no longer gives money, now holdable, gives +100 max HP, 10 ATK, 50 AP, 10 DEF and 10 SPE_DEF (previous stats of Eviolite)
- Repeat Ball is now unholdable and no longer gives SHIELD and SPEED. Unique Pokémon are more frequent in shops and can be found even after Legendaries are found.
- Shiny stone is now considered a synergy stone, given by Kecleon town encounter, on item carousels or by exchanging another synergy stone. Removed base stats and removed its effect of adding a second spotlight on the holder cell.
